pages.title: AI Researcher
pages.meta: Analogue Intelligence Research Lab, VU Amsterdam
body: I started this research group with Prof. Mauricio Verano Merino. It works on software engineering, creative computing, AI, hardware and robotics.
I also built the lab website, a 3D building with six rooms, custom shaders, characters and an achievement system.

pages.title: Teaching Assistant
pages.meta: Head TA for Introduction to Python Programming and Applied Programming for AI
body: I led labs and tutorials for Intro to AI, Introduction to Python, Intelligent Systems, Project Intelligent Systems, Applied Programming, Knowledge and Data, Logic and Sets, and Computational Intelligence.

I prepared technical and theory materials, graded assignments and projects, and helped students with Python, machine learning, evolutionary algorithms, knowledge representation and algorithmic thinking.

pages.title: Processing Community Day Amsterdam
pages.meta: A community event for creative coding and computational art
body: I co-organised the Amsterdam edition together with two other organisers and gave a p5.js workshop for beginners.

pages.title: Agentic AI Hackathon
body: We built a system of several AI agents that set prices, staffing and inventory for a simulated restaurant during changes in demand.
The agents run in a loop based on OODA (Strategist, Demand, Coordinator, Supply, Operations, Critic and Reflector) with a reflection step. The score went from negative to over 2,500.

pages.title: AI University Games
body: An AI agent that plans movie nights for a group of friends. A random forest matches personalities and preferences from Letterboxd data, and a website suggests screenings that fit everyone’s schedule.

pages.title: BR41N.IO
body: We used AI data analysis to translate brain signals into actions in a memory game built in Unity.

pages.title: Digital art preservation
body: Attended a workshop about preserving software based and net artworks, with practical tools for conservation and documentation.

pages.title: What I build with
body: Python, C++, Java, JavaScript, Prolog, SQL, SPARQL, HTML and CSS, p5.js.
PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit learn, XGBoost, Stable Baselines3, Gymnasium, MuJoCo, PyBullet, spaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face Transformers, Sentence Transformers, pandas and NumPy.
